title: Paste product information from ChatGPT
summary: Paste labeled text or JSON, review detected fields and fill the product form without an API call.

changes.detail: Open-by-default ChatGPT paste panel above link import. Supports French/English labels, JSON, bold labels, headings and two-column tables, with field preview and selection before applying.

Maps product name, brand, description, category, MAD price, original price, stock, tags and kg weight. Missing/empty fields are preserved; unsupported fields, currencies and ambiguous units produce warnings. No external AI call, persistence or publishing.
Applying a pasted name derives a slug only for new products; existing product URLs remain intact. Existing link import and writing assistant remain available.
